title: Inner-CV feature selection by LightGBM importance
spec: Fit LightGBM on all descriptors, keep the top 80 features by gain importance, and then refit LightGBM and the SVR on only those columns (the quantile transformer too). Keep the 50/50 blend. This trades noise features for a smaller, cleaner input.

title: Median-style robust blend with a second SVR on Morgan counts
spec: Add a second SVR with a precomputed min/max Tanimoto kernel on 2048-bit Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2), C=3, epsilon=0.1. Combine the three predictions (LightGBM, descriptor SVR, Tanimoto SVR) by taking their median per molecule rather than the mean. The median reduces the influence of a member that is off.

title: Median blend with Morgan-count SVR
spec: Build three predictions: LightGBM, the descriptor SVR, and a second RBF SVR on sqrt-transformed 1024-bit Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, gamma='scale', C=3). Return the median of the three per molecule, instead of the mean.

title: Stronger LightGBM regularization
spec: Change LightGBM params to num_leaves=7, min_child_samples=20, colsample_bytree=0.3, reg_lambda=5, n_estimators=800, learning_rate=0.02, and add extra_trees=True. This targets overfitting on 728 molecules with unseen scaffolds.

title: Descriptor-space PCA-whitened SVR plus LightGBM on PCA components
spec: Keep the quantile-normal descriptors. Compute PCA with 40 components (whiten=True, random_state=seed) on the training set. Append those components to the raw descriptors as extra LightGBM features. Fit the SVR on the PCA components only, with gamma='scale'. Blend 50/50.

title: MACCS keys + descriptors
spec: Concatenate MACCS keys (167 bits) with RDKit descriptors and fit an RF or ExtraTrees model.

title: Bolder: multi-kernel SVR on concatenated descriptor RBF and Morgan Tanimoto kernels
spec: Build a precomputed kernel K = 0.6*RBF(quantile-normalized descriptors, gamma=1/(n_features*var)) + 0.4*MinMax-Tanimoto(Morgan counts, radius 2, 2048 bits). Compute the MinMax kernel with a vectorized numpy loop over test rows, not an n×n×d tensor. Fit SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=3, epsilon=0.1) on K. Use it in place of the RBF SVR in the 50/50 blend with LightGBM.

title: SVR feature-subset bagging
spec: Replace the single SVR with an average of 10 RBF SVRs (C=3, eps=0.1, gamma='scale'). Each is fit on a random 60% column subset of the quantile-normalized descriptors, drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed+i). Average their predictions and blend 50/50 with LightGBM.

title: Residual stacking: SVR on LightGBM residuals
spec: Fit LightGBM first. Get out-of-fold LightGBM predictions on the training set with 5-fold KFold, and compute the residuals. Fit the SVR (C=1, epsilon=0.1) on the quantile-normalized descriptors to predict those residuals. The final prediction = LightGBM prediction + 0.7*SVR residual prediction. This replaces the 50/50 blend.

title: Descriptors plus atom-pair count SVD
spec: Compute hashed atom-pair count fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator, fpSize 2048, GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy) for train and test, reduce to 30 components with TruncatedSVD fitted on train only, and concatenate with the descriptors for LightGBM.

title: Winsorize training target
spec: At the start of fit_predict, clip y to the 2nd and 98th percentiles of the training y (np.percentile) before fitting both LightGBM and SVR. Predictions are not clipped. Reduces the influence of outlier labels on MAE.

title: MACCS for LightGBM only, retry with replicate
spec: Keep the current 50/50 LightGBM/SVR blend. Append 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys, as float32) plus 512-bit feature-Morgan (useFeatures=True, radius 2) count fingerprints to the descriptor matrix used only by LightGBM. The SVR keeps descriptors only, with its quantile transform fitted on descriptor columns only. Past runs of MACCS+FCFP gave 0.3599/0.3615.
